description: Main.cpp source file for a benchmarking tool related to Android Surface and OpenGL rendering, including setup, rendering, and timing of layered surface compositions.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: Represents a renderable layer with setup, rendering, and composition capabilities.

classes.name: BenchmarkRunner
classes.description: Handles setup, execution, and teardown of rendering benchmarks, including timing and frame management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the layer or benchmark runner, creating surfaces and configuring rendering.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated during setup.

methods.name: prepareComposition
methods.description: Prepares the layer for composition, updating textures.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Performs the composition of the layer.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the rendering loop for a specified number of frames and measures timing.
